verdict.rationale: While CrewAI's core config (YAML, Python) is inherently open and owned by the user, none of the evidence documents an explicit data-export feature or guarantee for data stored in the Memory system, CrewAI AMP/Enterprise deployments, or observability/tracing data — there's no stated mechanism for a user to pull out their crew execution history, memory store, or hosted-platform data in an open format and leave.
